question: Is direction D001 already explored or contradicted: Narrow to a single, hop-depth-conditional, matched-budget training-time experiment that separates the reasoning chain from peripheral same-passage context, and evaluate it under matched inference-time context against a training-free context baseline. Drop the repair loop and RL stage from the primary contribution (or demote them to clearly labeled secondary experiments), and treat the outcome as a pre-registered boundary/negative result about when context supervision helps rather than as a new state-of-the-art method.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
